title: Self-serve wash bays
details: Pull into any open bay and wash at your own pace, day or night. Each bay has a high-pressure wand and settings for soap, foam and wax. If it's your first time, give us a call or stop by between 9 and 5 and we'll walk you through it.

title: Dog wash
details: A wash station just for dogs, so the bath happens here instead of in your tub. Bring your dog along with the car and leave the mess behind. Call ahead if you have questions about using the dog wash.

title: Vacuums
details: Finish the inside after you wash the outside. The vacuums handle floors, seats, mats and trunks. They're available around the clock.
icon: <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 20h7"></path><path d="M7.5 20V9a4 4 0 0 1 4-4h0a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v3"></path><path d="M15.5 12l4 6h-8z"></path></svg>

title: Spot-free rinse
details: Use the spot-free rinse as your last step so your car dries clean without leaving water spots behind. Ask our staff if you're not sure which setting to use.

title: ATM
details: There's an ATM right on the lot, so you can get cash any time you're here.

title: Friendly help
details: Our staff are on-site every day from 9 AM to 5 PM. If something isn't working or you need a hand, find us on the lot or give us a call.
